posts.title: Posteriza
posts.description: POSTERIZA is a dynamic platform for showcasing innovative technological ideas through creative poster presentations. It encourages students to combine technical knowledge with impactful visual storytelling. Participants present their concepts in a clear, engaging, and visually appealing format. It’s where creativity and innovation come together to communicate ideas effectively.

rules.rule1: Send a soft copy of the poster to - posteriza2026@gmail.com

rules.rule3: If you are participating in a team of 2 members give the details of the team lead

posts.title: Code Clutch
posts.content: Spot the bugs. Fix the logic. Clutch the win.
posts.description: Code Clutch is an exciting debugging challenge designed to test your coding accuracy and problem-solving skills. Participants go through multiple rounds including MCQs, fill-in-the-blanks, and real-time debugging tasks. From identifying syntax errors to fixing complex logic, speed and precision are key to success. Compete with the best and prove your ability to crack code under pressure.

posts.title: Ideathon
posts.description: Ideathon is a platform to showcase your creativity by tackling real-world challenges with innovative solutions.Participants choose from domains like Agriculture, Sustainable Development, Biomedical, or Low Carbon Footprint.Present your ideas through a structured PPT and demonstrate practical, impactful thinking.Turn your vision into reality and make a difference through innovation.

posts.title: Logic Combat
posts.content: Battle of minds. Built on logic.
posts.description: Logic Combat is the ultimate digital challenge designed to push your analytical and problem-solving skills to the limit.Dive into a series of rounds featuring logical reasoning, technical puzzles, and design-based challenges.Step into a world of gates and grids where strategy, precision, and teamwork decide the winner.Gear up for an intense battle of wits and prove your logical dominance.

posts.title: Tech Quiz
posts.content: Think fast. Answer smarter. Win bigger.
posts.description: Tech Quiz is an exciting competition that tests your technical knowledge and quick thinking through multiple dynamic rounds. From technical questions to rebus puzzles, wordsearch, and rapid-fire challenges, every round keeps you on edge. Top teams advance to the oral quiz, where speed and accuracy determine the winners.Compete, learn, and showcase your intellect in this thrilling battle of brains.

posts.title: Tech Treasure Hunt
posts.content: Where clues spark circuits and logic leads to victory!
posts.description: Dive into an immersive technical adventure at Spoorthi Fest 2K26 with Tech Treasure Hunt. This multi-stage challenge combines problem-solving, electronics, and critical thinking in a unique way.Follow clues, crack puzzles, and build circuits as you progress through each level.Every step brings you closer to engineering success and ultimate victory.

posts.title: Proto Circuit
posts.description: ProtoCircuit is the ultimate electronics challenge, testing your skills from theory to hands-on hardware. Teams tackle four electrifying rounds: fundamentals, circuit decoding, simulation-based debugging, and real-world hardware building. Precision, speed, and teamwork are key as participants bring circuits to life. Compete, innovate, and prove your mastery in the world of electronics.
